llm_fields.description: The program equips artisans with skills for manufacturing footwear and leather goods, promoting the leather industry and enhancing artisans' livelihoods.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans belonging to listed sub‑castes among scheduled castes, be at least 18 years old, have an annual family income not exceeding ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas, must not have received benefits from other schemes except training programmes, and their family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organisations.
